fields.title: Designing a clean blog layout
fields.excerpt: A quick guide to structuring a readable blog page with reusable sections.
fields.content:
Start with a strong title and a short excerpt that sets context.

Use consistent spacing and typography to keep the reading flow comfortable.

Break long text with subheadings, images, and callouts so readers can scan.

fields.title: Building with component blocks
fields.excerpt: How to assemble landing pages faster by composing small, focused blocks.
fields.content:
Component blocks keep your UI consistent and easier to maintain.

Define a small set of shared blocks and reuse them across pages.

When you need variations, extend the block instead of duplicating it.

fields.title: Organizing your static assets
fields.excerpt: A simple folder strategy for CSS, JavaScript, and images in Django projects.
fields.content:
Keep CSS, JS, and images in predictable folders so templates stay clean.

Use descriptive names for assets and avoid deep nesting.

This makes it easier to onboard new contributors and track changes.
